description: List the evidence submissions workers have submitted for one of your bounties. Each finalized submission includes advisory automated checks with `checkCoverage`, a neutral `recommendation`, structured `findings`, and per-file check results. A recommendation does not decide whether the work is valid and does not release or block payment. Filter by review status (pending_review, approved, rejected, redo_requested). Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty whose evidence submissions to list

status.description: Filter submissions by review status: pending_review, approved, rejected, or redo_requested.

name: get_bounty_submissions
